title: Give back a value with gives back
objective: Return a value with gives back, including from inside an if, so a function can stop early.

body.text: gives back sends a value out of the function, and the function ends at that point. Any lines after it do not run. The value can be a number, text, or a result of a calculation or a comparison.

body.title: Double a number
body.code:
function double
    takes number called value
    gives back value times 2

say double 5

body.text: gives back can appear inside an if. The first one that runs ends the function, so you can write the special case first and the normal answer last.

body.title: Early answers
body.code:
function absolute
    takes number called value
    if value is less than 0
        gives back -value
    gives back value

say absolute -3

function choose name
    takes boolean called formal
    if formal
        gives back "Doctor"
    gives back "Friend"

say choose name true

body.prompt: This call is asking for the formal name, but the program prints Friend. Make it print Doctor.
body.starter:
function choose name
    takes boolean called formal
    if formal
        gives back "Doctor"
    gives back "Friend"

say choose name false
